name: Tomodachi Ijou Koibito Miman
source:
Shohei took a trip to Ryuujin-mura to heal his broken heart. He visited a historic shrine and freed a spirit who was sealed in a pot. She was Kukuri, a spirit who brought love to lonely people. The shrine’s miko Meiko makes him take responsibility for releasing Kukuri and the town is locked down, so he couldn’t return home. Will he be able to settle Kukuri’s disturbance and be freed from Meiko and return home?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
祥平為了撫平失戀的傷痛，來到龍神村旅行。他參拜了一座歷史悠久的神社，卻意外放出了封印在壺中的精靈。她名叫庫庫莉，是一名為孤獨之人帶來愛情的精靈。神社的巫女芽衣子要求祥平為釋放庫庫莉一事負責，偏偏村子又遭到封鎖，令他無法回家。他能否平息庫庫莉引發的騷動，擺脫芽衣子並返回自己的家？

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
